  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  November 14, 2024

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted as a Call-In at 1-669-900-6833, meeting
ID 985 1970 8884 and Password 514315 on November 14, 2024 at 2:04 pm.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Angel Leon - Martell, Planning Department
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, Los Angeles County Fire Department
  Sgt. Luis Jaramillo, Inglewood Police Department
  Raul Fernandez, Public Works Department

  Staff Present:  Aisha L. Thompson, City Clerk’s Office
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the item is
within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits & License
Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Approval of the minutes of the meeting held on October 24, 2024

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Teresa Estrada on behalf of The City of Inglewood to host a City of Inglewood Annual
  Turkey Giveaway Event at 1011 S. Stadium Dr. Hollywood Park, Private Property, on
  Wednesday, November 20, 2024 from 9:00 a.m. – 12:00 p.m.  APPROVED
  CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS: Approval for 1 day
  event; IPD will deploy two (2) police officers for public safety and two (2) TCO’s for
  intermittent traffic control. Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned
  immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall
  follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety
  guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State Health Department;
  and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code
  rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity
  No. 00385840)

Item #2:  Tracy Yeager on behalf of Greater Deliverence Church to host a Thanksgiving Free
  Outreach Fest Event at 6741 West Blvd., Private Property, on Saturday, November 23,
  2024 from 11:00 am – 2:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE

  FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS: Approval for 1 day event; Applicant to hire four (4)
  professional licensed security officers or off-duty law enforcement officers from their
  congregation; a watch Commander will be notified; Maintain site at all times, ensuring site
  is properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members
  working this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene and face
  mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State
  Health Department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood
  Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No. 00385522).

Item #3:  Sabrina Barnes on behalf of Delta Sigma Theta Soroity, Inc., to host a Family Heath and
  Wellness Fair Event at 111 N Locust St., Inglewood Senior Center, Public Property, on
  Saturday, December 7, 2024 from, 12:00 p.m. – 4:00 p.m APPROVED CONDITIONALLY
  SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS: Approval one day event; Applicant to
  hire one (1) professional licensed security officer ; a watch Commander will be notified
  Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the end of the
  event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social distancing,
  protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the
  LA.CO. Health Department and CA State Health Department; and Adhere to all State,
  Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations,
  including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00385458).

New Tobacco Retailer License Request (s):

Item #4:  Hane Zarzour DBA In N Out Smoke Shop to operate as a Gift Shop / Tobacco & Pipes at
  4314 W. Century Blvd. This Business License has been APPROVED with the following
  condition set forth by the Permits and Licenses Committee:Must adhere to all City of
  Inglewood Municipal Codes (IMC), specifically; CHAPTER 8: Article 8. REGULATIONS
  FOR BUSINESSES ENGAGED IN THE SALE OF TOBACCO PRODUCTS;Must adhere
  to all State and Federal Rules and Regulations; cigarettes is strictly prohibited; Sales of
  Flavored E-Cigarettes , Flavored Vapes ,Flavored E-juice, Flavored Pods, Flavored
  Cartridges, Menthol Cigarettes; Flavored little Cigars, Flavored Cigarillos, Flavored
  Smokeless Tobacco Products, Flavored Blunts Wraps, Flavored loose-leaf roll-your-own
  Tobacco, Flavored Tobacco rolling papers, Tobacco Product Flavored Enhancers are
  Strictly Prohibited;Sales of tobacco, hookah, vapor and e-cigarette products to minors,
  under age 21 is strictly prohibited; The display and sale of tobacco products or
  paraphernalia cannot exceed 25% of the retail floor area. Persons purchasing tobacco
  or any related tobacco products shall have a valid government-issued identification on their
  person at all times to enforce laws Prohibited;Sales of tobacco, hookah, vapor and e-
  cigarette products to minors, under age 21 is strictly prohibited; Persons purchasing
  tobacco or any related tobacco products shall have a valid government-issued identification
  on their person at all times to enforce laws restricting underage access to tobacco use,
  including hookah products; MUST HAVE VALID ABC LICENSE TO SALE ALCOHOL;
  TO Sales or display of any type of weapons, i.e., clubs, swords, knives, pepper spray,
  Taser/Stun guns is strictly prohibited;Tobacco Retailer business owners and/or new

  applicants or their designees are subject to random Permits & Licenses establishment
  inspections at any time of the day or night by any Police or Code Enforcement Officers,
  purpose of random inspections is to enforce business establishments to adhere to the
  regulations set forth by the City of Inglewood for Community Public Health &
  Safety;California State Board of Equalization Tobacco Retailers license must be
  current;Approval for retail sales of tobacco products within existing business ONLY;NO
  sales of tobacco (including vaporized / hookah products) to minors / underage persons. All
  persons purchasing tobacco or any related tobacco products SHALL have valid ID on their
  person at all times to ensure the restriction of underage tobacco use, including hookah
  products;Submit all state tobacco renewal certificates if applicable;NO loitering of persons
  outside of the location;NO LOITERING / PANHANDLING SIGNS MUST BE POSTED and
  visible to outside of the business. Proof of signage posted by applicant shall be submitted
  to finance (i.e. photo of signage); The following is not allowed: the “sales of Whippets are
  small cylinders of nitrous oxide”, the use of or illegal sales or cultivation of
  marijuana/cannabis products, any regulated cannabis products, any use or possession of
  illegal or unauthorized narcotics, narcotic paraphernalia per H&S11364.5 - i.e.; any pipes
  specifically used to ingest illegal narcotics, this would also include glass cylindrical, tube or
  bubble shaped pipes used specifically to smoke / ingest illegal narcotics. Sales of Tobacco
  pipes are acceptable; Applicant and employees are expected to be active participants in
  calling/notifying police for police related, unusual, illegal, and/or activity that may
  necessitate a police response or response from other city government services (i.e. Code
  Enforcement, Planning, Finance, Public Works, Fire Dept., Etc.);Applicant and employees
  are expected to be active participants in calling/notifying police for police related, unusual,
  illegal, and/or activity that may necessitate a police response or response from other city
  government services (i.e. Code Enforcement, Planning, Finance, Public Works, Fire Dept.,
  Etc.); andThe following is not allowed inside the business without proper authorization via
  the P&L Committee review and permit: PARTIES, SOCIAL EVENTS OR GATHERINGS
  OF ANYKIND, MUSIC BOXES (juke box), NO LIVE BANDS / MUSIC, DISC JOCKIES
  (DJ'S) PERFORMANCE, DANCE HALL, ETC. APPLICANT MUST HAVE REASONABLE
  BUSINESS HOURS (TIME OF DAY OR NIGHT) OF OPERATION. motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No. 00385530)
